title: I Tested Tom Sosnoff's Strategy for 3 Months — Here's What Happened
description:
I put one of the top options traders — Tom Sosnoff — to the test for 3 months. Real rules, real trades, real results: $11,357.50 in profit. In this video I break down exactly how the strategy works, the 3 key lessons I learned, the adjustments I made to Tom's approach, and I respond directly to the feedback (and pushback) from the comments.

🔑 THE 3-MONTH TEST RULES:
- $75,000 simulated account
- ES futures puts only
- 1 contract per trade, 1 trade per week
- 10 delta short puts (adjusted from Tom's approach)
- 45 DTE entry, 21 DTE management
- 50% profit target

This is real money documented week by week — not theory. I log every trade and it takes about an hour a week.
